title.en: Let Permit2 use the Safe's USDT: the approval Uniswap's app asks before a first swap
title.zh-TW: 讓 Permit2 動用 Safe 的 USDT：Uniswap app 第一次兌換前要求的授權

summary.en: The Safe calls USDT's `approve` to give Uniswap's Permit2 an unlimited allowance, the first of the steps the Uniswap app asks before a swap. No token moves. verify refuses any other spender or amount, and any other change to the Safe's balances or allowances.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫 USDT 的 `approve`，給 Uniswap 的 Permit2 無上限的授權，這是 Uniswap app 兌換前要求的第一步。沒有代幣移動。verify 拒絕其他的 spender 或數量，也拒絕 Safe 餘額或授權的任何其他變化。

text.en: The unlimited allowance stays open: Permit2 can then move USDT on any Permit2 approval or message the Safe signs.
text.zh-TW: 無上限的授權會一直留著：之後 Safe 簽的任何 Permit2 授權或訊息，Permit2 都能據以轉走 USDT。

pastTxsConclusion.en: Other Safes also sent this approval inside a MultiSend with the Permit2 allowance and the router's swap, which a card of the three operations covers. EOAs often reset USDT to 0 or approved an exact amount; this template refuses both.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 其他 Safe 也把這筆授權和 Permit2 授權、router 兌換放在同一個 MultiSend，這要用三個操作的卡片。EOA 常把 USDT 授權歸零或只授權剛好的數量；這個模板兩者都拒絕。

text.en: After this approval, a Permit2 message the Safe signs (an off-chain signature checked through the Safe's isValidSignature) can move the Safe's USDT to anyone it names, with no further transaction of the Safe.
text.zh-TW: 授權之後，Safe 簽的 Permit2 訊息（鏈下簽名，經 Safe 的 isValidSignature 驗證）就能把 Safe 的 USDT 轉給訊息指定的任何人，不需要 Safe 再發交易。

recommendation.en: Never sign a Permit2 message with the Safe. Swap through transactions that verify checks, and revoke the allowance when you stop using Uniswap.
recommendation.zh-TW: 不要用 Safe 簽 Permit2 訊息。用 verify 檢查得到的交易來兌換，不再用 Uniswap 時撤銷授權。

text.en: USDT refuses to change a nonzero allowance to another nonzero one. When the Safe already has a smaller allowance to Permit2, the app first sends a reset to 0, which this template gives MISMATCH.
text.zh-TW: USDT 不讓非零的授權直接改成另一個非零值。Safe 已經給 Permit2 較小的授權時，app 會先送一筆歸零的交易，這個模板對它的結果是 MISMATCH。

recommendation.en: If the app asks for a reset first, do not sign it on this template's MISMATCH; ask for a template for the reset.
recommendation.zh-TW: app 要先歸零時，不要在這個模板給 MISMATCH 的情況下簽；請另外要一個歸零用的模板。

text.en: Tether's owner can pause USDT, blacklist an address, or deprecate the contract so `approve` forwards to a new contract it names. Read on chain on 2026-11-27: not paused, not deprecated.
text.zh-TW: Tether 的 owner 可以暫停 USDT、把地址列入黑名單，或宣告合約停用，讓 `approve` 轉給它指定的新合約。2026-11-27 鏈上讀到：沒有暫停，沒有停用。

recommendation.en: If Tether announces a move of USDT to a new contract, ask for this report to be made again before you sign.
recommendation.zh-TW: Tether 宣布 USDT 換新合約時，簽之前請重做這份報告。

text.en: The app sends this approval alone, or in one MultiSend with the Permit2 allowance to the router and the swap. This template covers it alone; the MultiSend needs a card of uniswap/approve-permit2, uniswap/allow-router and uniswap/swap.
text.zh-TW: app 會單獨送這筆授權，或把它和給 router 的 Permit2 授權、兌換放在同一個 MultiSend。這個模板只管單獨那筆；MultiSend 要用 uniswap/approve-permit2、uniswap/allow-router、uniswap/swap 三個操作的卡片。

recommendation.en: Build the card from what the app proposes: this template alone, or all three in one card. A MISMATCH because of another shape means asking for its template.
recommendation.zh-TW: 照 app 提出的交易做卡片：單獨用這個模板，或三個一起放一張卡。因為形狀不同而 MISMATCH 時，請要那個形狀的模板。

role.en: The token whose allowance the Safe gives: USDT, issued by Tether
role.zh-TW: Safe 給出授權的代幣：Tether 發行的 USDT

text.en: Tether's page lists the address next to "USD₮ contract address", read again on 2026-11-27
text.zh-TW: Tether 的頁面在「USD₮ contract address」旁列出這個地址，2026-11-27 再讀一次

text.en: CoinGecko lists the coin tether at this address
text.zh-TW: CoinGecko 在這個地址列的代幣是 tether

text.en: Uniswap's StablePair hook deployments page lists it as USDT of the USDC / USDT pool on Ethereum
text.zh-TW: Uniswap 的 StablePair hook 部署頁在 Ethereum 的 USDC / USDT 池子把它列為 USDT

text.en: Etherscan: verified as TetherToken, solc 0.4.18; creation transaction 0x2f1c5c2b44f771e942a8506148e256f94f1a464babc938ae0690c6e34cd79190, sent by 0x36928500Bc1dCd7af6a2B4008875CC336b927D57
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：驗證為 TetherToken，solc 0.4.18；創建交易 0x2f1c5c2b44f771e942a8506148e256f94f1a464babc938ae0690c6e34cd79190，由 0x36928500Bc1dCd7af6a2B4008875CC336b927D57 送出

role.en: Uniswap's Permit2, the spender: it keeps token allowances for users and moves tokens by them or by a user's signed Permit2 message
role.zh-TW: Uniswap 的 Permit2，即 spender：替使用者保管代幣授權，依這些授權或使用者簽的 Permit2 訊息轉代幣

text.en: Uniswap's v4 deployments page lists the address in the Permit2 row under Ethereum, read again on 2026-11-27
text.zh-TW: Uniswap v4 部署頁在 Ethereum 的 Permit2 列出這個地址，2026-11-27 再讀一次

text.en: Uniswap/sdks: PERMIT2_ADDRESS is this address at the pinned commit and at main's tip
text.zh-TW: Uniswap/sdks：PERMIT2_ADDRESS 是這個地址，釘住的 commit 和 main 最新版都一樣

text.en: Uniswap/contracts deployments file for chain 1 lists it under Permit2
text.zh-TW: Uniswap/contracts 的 chain 1 部署檔把它列在 Permit2 下

text.en: Etherscan: verified as Permit2, solc 0.8.17; creation transaction 0xf2f1fe96c16ee674bb7fcee166be52465a418927d124f5f1d231b36eae65d377, sent by 0xD32Ff78579352cA78f416120A9f68b65c410871b through the public CREATE2 deployer
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：驗證為 Permit2，solc 0.8.17；創建交易 0xf2f1fe96c16ee674bb7fcee166be52465a418927d124f5f1d231b36eae65d377，由 0xD32Ff78579352cA78f416120A9f68b65c410871b 經公開的 CREATE2 deployer 送出

text.en: Permit2 source (SignatureTransfer): a transfer spends the owner's token allowance to Permit2 on the owner's signature alone, checked by isValidSignature for a contract such as a Safe
text.zh-TW: Permit2 原始碼（SignatureTransfer）：只要有 owner 的簽名就能動用 owner 給 Permit2 的代幣授權，合約（例如 Safe）的簽名用 isValidSignature 驗證

1.approve.spender.en: Who may spend the Safe's USDT: Permit2. Permit2 moves it only for a spender the Safe approved on Permit2 itself, or on a Permit2 message the Safe signed.
1.approve.spender.zh-TW: 誰可以動用 Safe 的 USDT：Permit2。Permit2 只替 Safe 在 Permit2 上授權過的 spender，或依 Safe 簽的 Permit2 訊息轉它。

1.approve.value.en: The allowance: 2^256-1, the largest number, which the app sends. USDT never lowers an allowance of this size when it is spent, so the app asks once per token.
1.approve.value.zh-TW: 授權數量：2^256-1，最大的數，app 送的就是它。這麼大的授權 USDT 用掉時不會減少，所以 app 每個代幣只要一次。
